propositions: Commit 40b8ac8295 activated runtime.py eagerly on every bridge pass, but runtime.py contains unconditional module-scope import of pydantic.SecretStr which is not available in core install without agents extra.

Scheduled reconcile-bridge runs fail with ModuleNotFoundError at runtime.py:39 before config/network because the bridge installs rebar core without [agents] while the reconciler must remain stdlib-only per pyproject.toml and docs/config.md.
Clean no-extras venv reproduces the exact runtime.py:39 traceback; historical A/B probes show success at 0f7461d243 and 557f8c16e35 but failure at 40b8ac8295 when runtime becomes eager.
StaticAuth credential masking and reveal behavior must be preserved while removing the undeclared Pydantic import prerequisite at module scope.
